guide.title: The Minot Country Club: Golf in Minot, North Dakota
guide.intro: Golf Digest's 2025-'26 ranking of the Best Golf Courses in North Dakota places The Minot Country Club first, labeled "Public," in Minot, Ward County. Two named sources disagree hard about what that label means in practice. Golf Digest's own course data records a $105 weekend fee and a "Daily Fee" facility type. The club's own website calls itself "a private club" in its own copy, routes its "TEE TIMES" navigation link to a member login page, and describes its reciprocal-play program, OpenRounds, as "included in your membership" and giving members access to "other private clubs nationwide." No page on minotcountryclub.com publishes a green fee, a public tee sheet, or a guest-without-member policy. The only sourced avenue for an outside golfer is the club's own phone number, (701) 852-3591. Golf Digest's own page disagrees with itself, too: its intro states "Three of the top-six ranked courses in North Dakota are open to the public," but four of its six entries carry the "Public" label — Minot is the fourth, the one that count leaves out. Minot's panel support is also the thinnest on the list: a 3.6 rating from just two panelists, tied for both measures with the lowest-rated, least-evaluated entries on the page. Golf Digest's own caveat about the state: "Though we struggle to get sufficient panelist coverage up in North Dakota, anyone who reports back about their experience at venues such as Hawktree Golf Club in Bismarck, Bully Pulpit in Medora or The Links of North Dakota are all happy they made the trip." For a North Dakota round a visitor can actually plan, this guide points to Hawktree Golf Club, Golf Digest's #2 in the state, also labeled "Public," in Bismarck.

sections.heading: Getting there
sections.body: Minot International Airport (MOT) is 5.6 road miles from The Minot Country Club, at 1912 Valley Bluffs Dr in Minot, Ward County. By road from the club, Hawktree Golf Club in Bismarck is 105.2 miles away, and The Links of North Dakota in Ray is 88.8 miles away. Bismarck Municipal Airport (BIS) is 113.6 road miles from the club, and Hector International Airport in Fargo (FAR) is 269.6 road miles away.

sections.heading: The Minot Country Club
sections.body: Golf Digest's 2025-'26 Best in State ranking lists The Minot Country Club first among North Dakota's six ranked courses, displaying the access label "Public" and recording the facility type as "Daily Fee," with a $105 weekend fee as of the ranking data's own November 14, 2025 update. The club plays across multiple tees ranging from 4,485 to 6,870 yards, per the club's own site. Golf Digest's panel counts for all six ranked North Dakota courses range from two to eight evaluations; Minot's #1 ranking rests on two, tied with Fargo Country Club for the fewest on the list, and its 3.6 rating is tied for the lowest, alongside the two Private-labeled clubs on the list. Golf Digest's own caveat about the state: "Though we struggle to get sufficient panelist coverage up in North Dakota, anyone who reports back about their experience at venues such as Hawktree Golf Club in Bismarck, Bully Pulpit in Medora or The Links of North Dakota are all happy they made the trip." No source available for this guide explains why Minot ranks first despite the lowest panel score and its absence from that same sentence.

sections.heading: Can you actually play it?
sections.body: Not by any route the club publishes. The Minot Country Club's own site calls itself "a private club" in its own copy — on its clubhouse page: "one of the most extensive and varied social calendars of any private club in the area." Its "TEE TIMES" navigation link sits under a "MEMBERS PAGE" menu and opens a member login. Its reciprocal-play program, OpenRounds, is described on the club's own site as "an exclusive online platform offering streamlined private club tee time accommodations, providing our members direct access to other private clubs nationwide," with access to that network "included in your membership." The club's membership page directs prospective members to "contact our Membership Director at (701) 852-3591." No page found on the operator's own site publishes a green fee, a public tee sheet, or a guest-without-member policy, and no season — opening date or closing date — is published for the course anywhere on the club's own site. The only sourced avenue for a visitor is to call the club directly at (701) 852-3591 and ask.

sections.heading: The practical round: Hawktree Golf Club
sections.body: Golf Digest ranks Hawktree Golf Club, in Bismarck, Burleigh County, second on the same 2025-'26 North Dakota list, displaying the same "Public" access label and "Daily Fee" facility type it gives The Minot Country Club. Golf Digest's own caveat about the state's thin panel coverage names Hawktree, by name, as one of three courses whose visitors "are all happy they made the trip" — a line the same page does not extend to its own #1. By road, Hawktree is 105.2 miles from The Minot Country Club. No source consulted for this guide records Hawktree's own site disputing Golf Digest's "Public" label the way Minot's own site disputes it.

sections.heading: Staying and eating in Minot
sections.body: Minot's own tourism site, visitminot.org, lists Hyatt House Minot and Hotel Revel among its lodging, and JL Beers and Ironhorse Kitchen + Bar among its restaurants.

faq.question: How do I book a tee time to play The Minot Country Club?
faq.answer: There is no published online route. The Minot Country Club's own site offers no online booking, no published green fee, and no public tee sheet for a non-member; its "TEE TIMES" link routes to a member login page, and its reciprocal-play program, OpenRounds, is "included in your membership" and gives members access to "other private clubs nationwide," not to the general public. The only sourced avenue for an outside golfer is to call the club directly at (701) 852-3591. Golf Digest labels the course "Public" and records a $105 weekend fee, but that figure comes from Golf Digest, not the club, and it is not corroborated anywhere on the operator's own site. For a North Dakota round you can plan around online, this guide points instead to Hawktree Golf Club, Golf Digest's #2 in the state, in Bismarck.

faq.question: Golf Digest ranks this course #1 and calls it "Public" — so why is there no way to book it?
faq.answer: Golf Digest's own course data shows the label "Public," facility type "Daily Fee," and a $105 weekend fee. The club's own site calls itself "a private club" in its own copy and gates every booking path behind a member login. Golf Digest's page also disagrees with itself: its own intro says "Three of the top-six ranked courses in North Dakota are open to the public," but four of its six entries — Minot included — carry the "Public" label. And Golf Digest's own caveat about the state reads: "Though we struggle to get sufficient panelist coverage up in North Dakota, anyone who reports back about their experience at venues such as Hawktree Golf Club in Bismarck, Bully Pulpit in Medora or The Links of North Dakota are all happy they made the trip." Minot's #1 ranking rests on two panelist evaluations and a 3.6 rating, the joint-lowest and joint-fewest-evaluated figures on the six-course list. No source explains the ranking despite these numbers, and none is offered here.

faq.question: What is the course's season?
faq.answer: Not published. No opening date or closing date for The Minot Country Club appears anywhere on the club's own site. This guide does not infer one.

faq.question: Where is the course, and what's the second course in the state?
faq.answer: The Minot Country Club is at 1912 Valley Bluffs Dr, Minot, Ward County, North Dakota; Minot International Airport (MOT) is 5.6 road miles away. The second course on this guide is Hawktree Golf Club in Bismarck, Burleigh County — Golf Digest's #2 in the state, also labeled "Public" and 105.2 road miles from The Minot Country Club.
